entities.name: Salladin Jalal al-Din Sultan ibn Tokhtamysh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jalal al-Din or Jalāl ad-Dīn was Khan of the Golden Horde from 1411 to 1412. He was the son of Tokhtamysh, Khan of the Golden Horde until 1395, by Ṭaghāy Beg Khatun, the daughter of Ḥājjī Beg. In Russian texts, he is also known as Zeleni-Saltan, sometimes translated as 'Green Sultan'.
